dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple light-intensity elliptical rings (annuli) are visible along the upper dorsal surface. A prominent sequence of four discrete structures exhibits a sharp gradient transition from the dark background pelage to a high-intensity light perimeter, often enclosing a dark interior core.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: A high concentration of irregular, high-intensity pixel clusters is located along the mid-to-lower lateral flank and pectoral transition zone. these clusters are amorphous and lack the internal gradient or ring structure seen in the dorsal annuli.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: A primary horizontal alignment of four centroid points is formed by the prominent dorsal annuli. A secondary triangular grouping is identifiable below this line, formed by the centroids of three larger, more complex irregular annuli on the lateral torso.

other_distinctive_markers: The anterior cervical region displays an extensive reticulated network of interconnected high-intensity mottle, distinct from the more isolated and discrete ring patterns found on the posterior trunk.
